title: ID0415904-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002841]PCB out of order
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Right PCB out of order, left PCB charging is only possible after several attempts - due to LEM meter error → time synchronization error
Workaround: Reboot
Solution: Update to v6.1.3
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-03-31

additional_info.subject: ID0415904-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002841]PCB out of order CRM:02681000037
additional_info.body:
Hello, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
My name is Francisco and I am supporting you today. I noticed that the meter of the DC2 is having a time synchronization issue. In the latest firmware we are using a different method to synchronize the time.
I recommend to update this charging station from v6.0.3 to v6.1.3 and see if the problem is completely solved.
If not then I will return after investigating further.
Please let me know if you prefer to have it updated in a certain time or if I can do it whenever it's free. The update is already ready to be activated.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0415904-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002841]PCB out of order CRM:02681000037
additional_info.body:
Good morning,
I have performed a reboot on the charging station since no one was charging and the DC2 is back to available.
I suggest to update the charger to v6.1.3 since there is a fix for this error.
I will wait until the end of the day for your reply, since the issue has been resolved I will close the ticket after your feedback.
Thank you and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco
